summary: Medium and small completed, but tiny stopped at about step 4,452 and was not evaluated; the planned three-arm fixed-FLOPs comparison is incomplete.

comparisons.interpretation: Metrics disagree and optimizer-step counts differ by roughly 10x.

deviations: Tiny stopped around step 4,452 of 15,217 and has no held-out metric.
The wrapper's EXIT trap wrote COMPLETE even though the final run arm and result-writing stage were missing.
The retrospective manifest was reconstructed after the run.
The design intentionally changes optimizer-step counts as a consequence of fixed estimated FLOPs.

failures.message: The retained log ends at progress 4452/15217 and immediately writes COMPLETE; no structured termination reason was retained.

observed: Medium and small completed held-out evaluation; tiny did not.
Small had 0.2706 dB higher mean-frame PSNR, while medium had 0.2019 higher SSIM.
Medium did receive bootstrap training after step 237; late boot_mse was non-zero.
interpretation: The very low fixed-compute budget creates severe optimization imbalance and does not isolate capacity.
not_established: That larger models hurt rollout quality.
decision: Run tiny, small, and medium for the same 20,000-step compressed curriculum.

revision_history.reason: Retrospective backfill; corrected wrapper COMPLETE to experiment-level aborted and corrected the shortcut-training interpretation.
